name: gaps3-ghost-squad
description: audit-gaps-3 (gate TI4_RULES_AC): Ghost Squad — "After another player commits units to land on a planet you control: Move any number of your ground forces from any planet you control in the active system to any other planet you control in the active system." The original only posted a reminder (the moves were free-form). Base pbd104@59: muaat controls Meer and Arinam (205) with 2 infantry on Meer; letnev activates 205; muaat plays Ghost Squad and resolves it: the offered moves are exactly those between muaat's planets in the active system (ghostSquadMove_<from>_<to>_<unit>, refused outside those limits), and one infantry moves Meer to Arinam.
